coverage.method: Explicit allowlist. Lexical whole-file scan plus semantic reading of recorded ranges; no new broad crawl.
limits: Corpus is not all of C:\IALD; negative findings are coverage-limited.
Tratado scientific sections01-06,08-09,main and appendices; prolegomena, consciousness, ethics/legal and conclusion not rescanned.
Existing paper source read as bytes only; tgl_paper_unified.py was never imported or run.
No DOCX/PDF re-extraction, no observed data, tests, dynamics, providers or Lean builds.
Historical source labels and statements are preserved; this report does not revalidate every historical theorem or numerical claim.

findings.relation: Boundary passive matrix on H_obs (+) H_hid: [[sqrt(1-beta)e^(i theta_T),sqrt(beta)e^(i theta_R)],[-sqrt(beta)e^(-i theta_R),sqrt(1-beta)e^(-i theta_T)]], with beta=|R|^2=sin^2(theta_M).
findings.status_exact: Source explicitly conditional: REAL dado |R|^2=beta; finite-to-gravitational-boundary transfer remains CONJECTURE. Unitarity fixes the sum, not the chosen value beta by itself.
findings.limit: The relation b=beta exists in the written architecture. It does not prove physical access to both hidden/observable input and output channels, nor identify the device realization of this matrix.

findings.status_exact: The source says beta is primary and the angle is derived; sin^2+cos^2=1 alone is normalization, not a derivation of beta.
findings.limit: No identification P_2D with the actual pair number/quadrature observable or detector POVM is supplied in these passages.

findings.relation: alpha=sech(chi/2), q=tanh(chi/2), q^2+alpha^2=1; beta=sqrt(e)alpha; a separate SO(2) coefficient transport relates EM and gravitational matrices.
findings.status_exact: The later caveat at1288 marks alpha_obs=sech as ONTO and keeps CODATA as INPUT. The source describes coefficient transport, not alpha-free derivation.
findings.limit: chi, q and the two-face transmission model are not identified with rho or the bosonic pair number distribution of R59. Repeated hyperbolic functions do not establish equality of objects.

findings.relation: beta_halo~2-3 is the halo slope; beta_C=1/T_C and beta=1/(k_B T) are thermal; beta_2=1 is a Betti number; historical alpha_2 is declared renamed beta_TGL.
findings.status_exact: The historical alpha_2 subscript is not alpha^2, the squared fine-structure constant. beta_TGL is alpha_FINE_CODATA_2018*sqrt(e) in the adopted runtime convention.
findings.limit: No literal local beta or shared Greek letter transfers its value to beta_TGL. Historical naming statement located, not a newly proved physical identification.

findings.relation: Two-mode squeezed state, normalized quadratures, homodyne tomography with phase-locked adjustable local oscillator and phase scan are explicitly prescribed.
findings.status_exact: Documentary preparation/readout protocol and prediction, not evidence it was performed. This directly supports relative pair/quadrature reading even when linear means vanish.
findings.limit: The tomography section reconstructs rho_ss/Name subspace. It supplies no equality between recovered squeezing parameters and beta_TGL.

findings.relation: Appendix133 gives Var(Xi-Xj)=exp(-2r) but Var(Pi+Pj)=exp(+2r);139 assigns uncertainty bound>=1/2 to that EPR pair.
findings.status_exact: For the written S and aligned phase, R59 gives both variances exp(-2r). Xi-Xj and Pi+Pj commute. The source also mixes variances and standard deviations in139.
findings.limit: This mismatch is an erratum candidate beside the source, not removal of the squeezed state or tomography route. No source edited and no new test round.

findings.relation: Graviton coefficient rho=r; Tratado coefficient rho=r/2; same aligned dimensionless variance exp(-2rho) is exp(-r) in the latter.
findings.status_exact: R59 already derived this; the two written r symbols cannot be equated without conversion.
findings.limit: Neither convention supplies rho(beta), phi(beta) or a calibration of physical units.

findings.relation: Within the pure squeezed family: rho_eff=asinh(sqrt(n))=asinh(2|m|)/2, phi=arg(m), consistency |m|^2=n(n+1); phi unidentifiable at rho=0.
findings.status_exact: State tomography relative to quadrature phase reference, not a derivation of rho(beta), theory fitting, or a measurement performed here.
findings.limit: A mixed state can fail the pure equality; phase reconstruction alone does not identify the preparation/model. No rho=atanh(sqrt(beta)) is inferred.

findings.relation: Passive angular matrix mixes annihilation modes linearly and preserves number; active squeezing mixes annihilation and creation hyperbolically. Tomita S=J Delta^(1/2), modular cocycle and scattering S are separately typed in the source.
findings.status_exact: R59 supplies real symplectic Bogoliubov map k_rho, not a complex one-particle unitary. Shared letter S or identities involving tanh/sech do not identify these operators.
findings.limit: Even an eventual composition of active preparation with passive readout needs the actual channel map and admissible states; neither beta alone nor unitarity fixes the source squeeze.

findings.relation: No explicit physical equation relating the R59 covariance (n,m or rho,phi) to the particular beta_TGL reflection channel was located in the scanned sources.
findings.status_exact: There IS a documentary reflection/projection relation with beta. What remains is its identification with this pair, this preparation and physically accessible observables.
findings.limit: No universal absence claim. R5 remains open; no R4 dynamics, recovery, reset or acceptance attempted.

precise_residual: Identify, from the same device modes and state preparation, the actual observable/POVM implementing the obs/hidden reflection readout, its input/output access and normalization, and prove its value equals the source beta_TGL. Do not assume beta=n/(n+1), rho=atanh(sqrt(beta)), chi/2=rho or equal scattering/squeezing phases. Refinement, dynamics and Maxwell/H1 identification remain distinct R5 obligations.
